work_class: The project includes upgrading Aeration Basins 1 and 2 at the GLWA wastewater treatment facility. The work involves replacing two existing pumps with larger, more efficient variable-speed pumps, improving the treatment process to handle higher wet weather flows, and adding controls and hydraulic improvements to keep basin water levels more stable. The upgrades will also improve energy efficiency, reduce oxygen usage, and enhance phosphorus removal to meet environmental permit requirements. In addition, the project includes rehabilitation of the facility's structural, architectural, mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation systems to extend the facility's service life by approximately 30 years and support continued compliance with GLWA discharge permits.

Suite #410

General Scope of Work:
Interior build-out/renovation of an existing commercial suite for a periodontics dental practice.
Scope includes demolition and new construction as needed to create the proposed dental office layout. 
Minor renovation on patient-facing areas and administrative spaces.
Work includes new interior partitions, doors, ceilings, flooring, painting, finishes, and general interior improvements.

Electrical Scope:
Electrical work includes lighting, receptacles, switching, and dedicated equipment power.
Electrical scope supports dental equipment, sterilization equipment, office equipment, mechanical equipment, and general practice operations.

Plumbing work includes restroom fixtures, sinks, related plumbing infrastructure, and dental equipment connections (Med Gas).
Plumbing scope supports treatment areas, sterilization/support areas, and restrooms.

Mechanical / HVAC Scope:
Mechanical work includes ventilation, providing one exhaust for the med gas closet.
Existing building HVAC equipment is assumed to remain with no modifications.

Medical Gas Scope:
Medical gas work includes nitrous and oxygen service for the dental treatment areas.
Scope includes related piping, connections, inspections, and coordination for medical gas systems.

Fire Alarm / Life Safety Scope:
Relocation of devices and sprinkler heads. No new devices.
